entries.title: Romans 10:1
segments: Brothers, truly my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is for [it] to be saved.

entries.title: Romans 10:2
segments: For I bear record to them that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

entries.title: Romans 10:3
segments: For they, being ignorant of God's righteousness and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves to the righteousness of God.

entries.title: Romans 10:4
segments: For Christ [is] the end of the law for righteousness for everyone who believes.

entries.title: Romans 10:5
segments: For Moses writes [of] the righteousness [which] is of the Law, "The man who does those things shall live by them."

entries.title: Romans 10:6
segments: But the righteousness of faith says this: "Do not say in your heart, Who shall ascend into Heaven?" that is, to bring Christ down;

entries.title: Romans 10:7
segments: or "Who shall descend into the deep?"; that is, to bring up Christ again from [the] dead.

entries.title: Romans 10:8
segments: But what does it say? "The word is near you, [even] in your mouth and in your heart"; that is, the word of faith which we proclaim;

entries.title: Romans 10:9
segments: Because if you confess the Lord Jesus, and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from [the] dead, you shall be saved.

entries.title: Romans 10:10
segments: For with [the] heart [one] believes unto righteousness, and with [the] mouth [one] confesses unto salvation.

entries.title: Romans 10:11
segments: For the Scripture says, "Everyone believing on Him shall not be put to shame."

entries.title: Romans 10:12
segments: For there is no difference both of Jew and of Greek, for the same Lord over all is rich to all who call on Him.

entries.title: Romans 10:13
segments: For everyone, "whoever shall call on the name of [the] Lord will be saved."

entries.title: Romans 10:14
segments: How then shall they call on Him in whom they have not believed? And how shall they believe in Him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without preaching?

entries.title: Romans 10:15
segments: And how shall they preach unless they are sent? As it is written, "How beautiful [are] the feet of those who preach the gospel of peace and bring glad tidings of good things!"

entries.title: Romans 10:16
segments: But [they have] not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our report?"

entries.title: Romans 10:17
segments: Then faith [is] of hearing, and hearing by the Word of God.

entries.title: Romans 10:18
segments: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes indeed, their voice went out into all the earth, and their words to the end of the world.

entries.title: Romans 10:19
segments: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses says, "I will provoke you to jealousy by [those who are] no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you."

entries.title: Romans 10:20
segments: But Isaiah [is] very bold and says, "I was found by those who did not seek Me, I became known to those who did not ask after Me."

entries.title: Romans 10:21
segments: But to Israel He says, "All day long I have stretched forth My hands to a disobeying and gainsaying people."
